title: e-means clusters embeddings with far fewer passes than k-means
summary: Meta's e-means updates cluster centers with small batches and an exponential moving average, and uses scaling laws to set batch size and learning rate. On embedding datasets it reaches lower error in 1.4 to 2.6 epochs versus 25 for k-means, with reported 10x to 45x GPU speedups, and can cluster 10 billion embeddings into 16 million groups in 2.5 epochs.

appearances.title: Meta releases e-means clustering in FAISS
appearances.summary: Meta released e-means in FAISS 1.16.0, a drop-in k-means replacement whose batch size and step size are set by scaling laws, so the only choice is the number of clusters. The authors report about 10 times fewer epochs and order-of-magnitude CPU and GPU wall-clock speedups, tested on 26 datasets from 100,000 to 10 billion points.
